as_told.title: Girlfriend's forehead implant pulses RF transmissions

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he interviewed a man named Bob Maguire, whose girlfriend has an implant in her head. According to Michels, Maguire held an RF detector, a device that picks up radio signals, over her head and could measure the frequency coming out of it. If true, it would mean the implant is an active device sending out a signal.
